shortDescription: Moca Network (MOCA) is scheduled to unlock about 167.65 million tokens at 12:00 AM on October 11 (UTC+8), according to token unlock data from Web3 asset data platform RootData. According to ChainCatcher, the unlocked tokens are valued at about $1.71 million.
